summary: Evidence files exist and cited numbers are present; the 129-run unguarded re-measure reproduced the stored r4 numbers exactly and refusal sentences are clean (362 distinct, no engine words, one sentence each). But the claimed curved bar (3e-4) fails at small sketch scale with no guard check, every guard-dependent supported row rests on round-3 data I could not replay, and the sweep oracle is volume+bbox only and partly built from the guard's own solver.

defects.problem: The 3e-4 curved volume bar is a relative figure fitted at 10-40 mm. At sketch scale 0.01 the kernel is 4e-4 to 8e-4 off the closed form and at 0.001 it is 3e-3 to 9e-3 (circle d=0.014: 1.5255e-6 vs 1.5394e-6), and nothing in the guard checks the solid against the sketch area, so a tiny curved sketch builds and reports a volume 0.3-0.9% off with no refusal. Tiny scale is not among the swept cases; guard residual tolerance for curved rules is an absolute 1e-3 mm (guard.mjs RES_TOL.mmCurved).

Statuses describe an unwired prototype guard whose outcome numbers (guarded 0 wrong of 3040) come only from round-3 runs on a wrapper2 pkg that no longer exists; sketch-constraints.json recheck says so itself. The guarded route could not be independently replayed here. One fresh unguarded replay contradicts a supported row: sk-circle-arc-tangent__slot-r6-L30-floating rough3.5 builds 3634.8 vs closed form 4731.0 (23% wrong, bbox y from -11.5), while the row 'saved FreeCAD refs, remaining sketch fixtures' reports shipped built-right 12 of 12 on its own (different) starts.

defects.feature: sweep scoring (rough start rows, branch check rows)
defects.problem: classifyImg scores a build right on volume and bbox only, and the set of acceptable mirror images is derived from the guard's own ladderSketch solution, so a shape with the same area and bbox but a different outline, or a branch the guard itself mis-solves, is scored MATCH. No second oracle judges shape (brep-rs refuses circle-circle, symmetric trapezoid, symmetric-about-construction-line, so those 8 sweep cells at 3.5%/15% have closed form only).
Cited paths use '...' abbreviations and 'out/sentences.json' does not exist (file is sentences.jsonl); 7 of 30 path tokens do not resolve literally.
Some sentences say 'the solver would pick a different one' / 'the solver cannot swing a line'; these are not in the banned list but are solver talk for a student.
